feed_summary: Security teams have never lacked vulnerability data. The harder problem is deciding which issues create a credible path to business impact, then acting before that path can be used. As frontier AI makes it faster and less expensive to connect weaknesses, operational assumptions, and legitimate system behavior, that decision window is becoming even tighter. The Gartner® report, Mythos Reprioritizes Cybersecurity Outcomes and Investments , examines what this shift means for cybersecurity priorities and investment. Rapid7 is offering complimentary access to the research, which we believe can help security leaders reassess how they prioritize exposure and infrastructure teams reassess how they plan response and recovery. Why does AI change the vulnerability management equation? Gartner states,
title: Gartner Report: The Attack Path is Closing Faster than Most Teams Can Patch
